none: PAS NLM-8D6C83: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine, probably a fallen horseman issue of 355-361, Reece period 18. Detail of bust might hint at Trier mint. Obverse description: Bust cuirassed and pearl diademed right; stiff vertical hair. Reverse description: Soldier advancing left spearing fallen horseman. Reverse inscription: FEL TE[MP REPARATIO]. In exergue: [--]H. Diameter: 14.1mm, Weight: 1.18gms, die axis: probably 6
